      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "introduce proxy_port(n) rather than misusing p2p_port(n) for the SOCKS5 proxy",
      "quote": "This is somewhat of a misuse of `p2p_port()`. It works, but looking at it I wonder if it can be done better. Maybe introduce `proxy_port(n)`?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author set port to 0 as suggested by vasild once port 0 support was added",
      "author_replies": ["rc:2847935240"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:2847935240",
      "status_by_quote": "done"

      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "allow tests using auto_outbound_mode to override redirection decisions and listener creation",
      "quote": "then it is possible to override from the test: * the decision where to redirect and * the listener creation",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author implemented auto_outbound_factory",

      "other_replies": [],

      "status_by_id": "rc:2611923854",

    },
    {
      "id": "rc:2611907262",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "manually performing arithmetic on ports risks port collisions across parallel tests or invalid port ranges",
      "quote": "my preference would be to not call `+` or `+=` on an integral port returned by a helper function. This will lead to issues down the line",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author cherry-picked commit enabling port=0 for OS port allocation",
      "author_replies": ["rc:2611923052", "rc:2656686924"],
      "other_replies": ["rc:2613108267"],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:2656686924",
      "status_by_quote": "I cherry-picked the commit from #34186, making it possible to use `port=0` and then let the OS deal with it - much bette"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:2675425492",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "unify auto_outbound_factory and _create_auto_outbound_listener interfaces to return the listener and remove conditional logic",

      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author unified the listener factory interface",

      "other_replies": [],

      "status_by_quote": "I like that suggestion - took it!"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:2675441115",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "use format_addr_port() for the proxy address in case an IPv6 address is configured",
      "quote": "Maybe this needs `format_addr_port()` as well, in case the address happens to be IPv6 and needs to be enclosed in `[]`?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "accepted",
      "status_note": "author noted proxy address is hardcoded to 127.0.0.1; vasild conceded it only matters if changed in the future",
      "author_replies": ["rc:2848157654"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:2851577930",
      "status_by_quote": "Right, only if changed in the future."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:2675530659",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "make node argument consistent across helper functions or drop it from all since all operate on self.nodes[0]",

      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author dropped node argument across helper functions",
      "author_replies": ["rc:2848516997"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:2848516997",
      "status_by_quote": "I decided to drop the node arg everywhere."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:2675557061",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "question",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "whether a stale-tip extra-outbound connection could be initiated between advancing mocktime and calling generate",
      "quote": "Is there an unlikely scenario that a stale-tip extra-outbound connection is initiated after advancing the mocktime and before `self.generate(node, 1)`?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author explained CheckForStaleTipAndEvictPeers fires on steady clock independent of mocktime",
      "author_replies": ["rc:2848376745"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:2848376745",
      "status_by_quote": "I think probably not in practice - `CheckForStaleTipAndEvictPeers` fires every 45 seconds (on a steady clock, not influe"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:2675662381",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "question",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "whether the node could already have connections to all reachable networks when the function starts, causing has_extra_full_outbound_peer to time out",
      "quote": "Is it possible that the node already has at least one connection to all reachable networks when this function starts? Would that result in timeouts due to `has_extra_full_outbound_peer(node)` never re",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author notes wait_for_network_specific_peer no longer exists in overhauled test",
      "author_replies": ["rc:2848465764", "rc:4617100892"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4617100892",
      "status_by_quote": "I believe this is no longer an issue with the current version of the test (wait_for_network_specific_peer no longer exists)."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:2851521722",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "pass requested destination address and port to auto_outbound_factory in addition to connection index",
      "quote": "auto_outbound_factory() might benefit from getting more information about the connection, in addition to its index, like the requested address and port",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author explained this is no longer relevant due to addrbind matching",
      "author_replies": ["rc:4617127009"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4617127009",
      "status_by_quote": "I think this is also no longer relevant, because of the `addrbind`-based matching used now."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:2937432442",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "add a comment explaining the origin and logic behind the magic number 46",
      "quote": "Could you add a brief comment explaining where 46 comes from?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author added explanation in test",
      "author_replies": ["rc:4616609972"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4616609972",
      "status_by_quote": "done, added a short explanation."
    }
  ],
